# Data process
```{r}
adm_enough_sample <-
  blogs_pollution[, .(num_date_keywords = sum(keywords_n != 0)), by = .(SA2_CODE21)]
```


# Panel data
```{r}
blogs_pollution_pm25 <-
  merge(blogs_pollution,
        pm25,
        by = c("date", "SA2_CODE21")) %>%
  # filter the adm unit with enough sample
  .[SA2_CODE21 %in% adm_enough_sample[num_date_keywords>30, SA2_CODE21]] %>%
  .[keywords_n>0]
```


```{r}
# dependent variable
blogs_pollution_pm25[, total_asinh := asinh(total_n)]

# controls
blogs_pollution_pm25[, keywords_asinh := asinh(keywords_n)]

# Fixed-effects
blogs_pollution_pm25[, dow := lubridate::wday(date, week_start = 1)]
blogs_pollution_pm25[, dow1 := ifelse(dow == 1, 1, 0)]
blogs_pollution_pm25[, dow2 := ifelse(dow == 2, 1, 0)]
blogs_pollution_pm25[, dow3 := ifelse(dow == 3, 1, 0)]
blogs_pollution_pm25[, dow4 := ifelse(dow == 4, 1, 0)]
blogs_pollution_pm25[, dow5 := ifelse(dow == 5, 1, 0)]
blogs_pollution_pm25[, dow6 := ifelse(dow == 6, 1, 0)]
```


```{r}
adm_list <-
  blogs_pollution_pm25[, .(SA2_CODE21)] %>%
  unique()
```


# Detect change point
```{r}
detectCP <- function(panel){
  q25 <- 
    quantile(panel$PM25, probs=0.25)
  q99 <- 
    quantile(panel$PM25, probs=0.99)
  
  best_aic <- Inf
  best_cp <- NA
  sequence <- seq(q25, q99, by = 1)

  aic_values <- numeric(length = length(sequence)) 
  cp_index <- 1
  
  for(potential_cp in sequence){
    panel[, I_gt_cp := ifelse(PM25>=potential_cp, 1, 0)]
    
    panel[, interaction_term := (PM25-potential_cp)*I_gt_cp]
    
    model_detect_cp <-
      lm(keywords_asinh ~ 
           I_gt_cp + interaction_term + 
           total_asinh + 
           dow1 + dow2 + dow3 + dow4 + dow5 + dow6,
         data = panel)

    current_aic <- AIC(model_detect_cp)
    aic_values[cp_index] <- current_aic
    
    if (current_aic < best_aic) {
      best_aic <- current_aic
      best_cp <- potential_cp
    }
    
    cp_index <- cp_index + 1
  }
  
  return(best_cp)
}
```


```{r}
best_cp_list <-
  lapply(adm_list$SA2_CODE21, function(adm_spec){
    detectCP(blogs_pollution_pm25[SA2_CODE21 == adm_spec])
  }) %>% unlist()

adm_list[, best_cp := best_cp_list]
```


# Fit model
```{r}
fitModel <- function(panel, best_cp){
  panel[, I_gt_cp := ifelse(PM25>=best_cp, 1, 0)]
  panel[, interaction_term := (PM25-best_cp)*I_gt_cp]
  
  fit_model <- 
    lm(keywords_asinh ~ 
         I_gt_cp + interaction_term + 
         total_asinh + 
         dow1 + dow2 + dow3 + dow4 + dow5 + dow6,
       data = panel)

  coef <-
    summary(fit_model)$coef %>%
    as.data.table() %>%
    cbind(coef = row.names(summary(fit_model)$coef)) %>%
    # confidence level
    cbind(as.data.table(confint(fit_model, level = 0.95))) %>%
    setnames(old = c("2.5 %", "97.5 %"),
             new = c("Estimate_lwr", "Estimate_upr")) %>%
    # scale to an approximate percentage change
    .[, Estimate := exp(Estimate)-1] %>%
    .[, Estimate_lwr := exp(Estimate_lwr)-1] %>%
    .[, Estimate_upr := exp(Estimate_upr)-1] %>%
    # filter the coef
    .[coef == "interaction_term"]
  
  return(coef)
}
```


```{r}
coef_list <-
  lapply(1:nrow(adm_list), function(i){
    fitModel(blogs_pollution_pm25[SA2_CODE21 == adm_list[i, SA2_CODE21]],
             adm_list[i, best_cp])
  }) %>% rbindlist()

adm_list <- 
  cbind(adm_list, coef_list)
```


# Predict model
```{r}
predictModel <- function(panel, best_cp, city){
  panel[, I_gt_cp := ifelse(PM25>=best_cp, 1, 0)]
  panel[, interaction_term := (PM25-best_cp)*I_gt_cp]
  
  fit_model <- 
    lm(keywords_asinh ~ 
         I_gt_cp + interaction_term,
       data = panel)
  
  pred_with_ci <-
    predict(fit_model,
            newdata = panel,
            type = "response",
            level = 0.95,
            se.fit = T)
  
  ci <- 1.96 * pred_with_ci$se.fit 
  panel$fit_lower <- pred_with_ci$fit - ci
  panel$fit_upper <- pred_with_ci$fit + ci
  panel$fit <- pred_with_ci$fit
  
  return(panel)
}
```


```{r}
predict_list <-
  lapply(1:nrow(adm_list), function(i){
    predictModel(blogs_pollution_pm25[SA2_CODE21 == adm_list[i, SA2_CODE21]],
                 adm_list[i, best_cp],
                 adm_list[i, SA2_CODE21])
  }) %>% rbindlist(fill = T)
```


```{r}
city_filter <-
  adm_list[!is.na(Estimate) & `Pr(>|t|)`<0.05 & Estimate>=0]

predict_list_filter <-
  merge(city_filter[, .(SA2_CODE21, best_cp, Estimate)],
        predict_list,
        all.x = T,
        by = "SA2_CODE21") %>%
  .[PM25 < best_cp, fit := 0]
```

# Predict model in global
```{r}
predict_panel <-
  blogs_pollution_pm25[SA2_CODE21 %in% city_filter$SA2_CODE21]

best_cp <-
  detectCP(predict_panel)

predict_panel[, I_gt_cp := ifelse(PM25>=best_cp, 1, 0)]
predict_panel[, interaction_term := (PM25-best_cp)*I_gt_cp]

predict_panel[, sum_total_n := sum(total_n, na.rm = T), by = .(SA2_CODE21)]

fit_model <- 
  lm(keywords_asinh ~ 
       I_gt_cp + interaction_term,
     data = predict_panel
     )

pred_with_ci <-
  predict(fit_model,
          newdata = predict_panel,
          type = "response",
          level = 0.95,
          se.fit = T)

ci <- 1.96 * pred_with_ci$se.fit
predict_panel$fit_lower <- pred_with_ci$fit - ci
predict_panel$fit_upper <- pred_with_ci$fit + ci
predict_panel$fit <- pred_with_ci$fit

predict_panel[PM25 < best_cp, fit := 0]
predict_panel[PM25 < best_cp, fit_upper := 0]
predict_panel[PM25 < best_cp, fit_lower := 0]
```


# Output fitted coef in global
```{r}
coef_global <-
  summary(fit_model)$coef %>%
  as.data.table() %>%
  cbind(coef = row.names(summary(fit_model)$coef)) %>%
  # confidence level
  cbind(as.data.table(confint(fit_model, level = 0.95))) %>%
  setnames(old = c("2.5 %", "97.5 %"),
           new = c("Estimate_lwr", "Estimate_upr")) %>%
  # scale to an approximate percentage change
  .[, Estimate := exp(Estimate)-1] %>%
  .[, Estimate_lwr := exp(Estimate_lwr)-1] %>%
  .[, Estimate_upr := exp(Estimate_upr)-1] %>%
  # filter the coef
  .[coef == "interaction_term"]
```


# Output plot
```{r}
p1 <-
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(predict_list_filter,
            mapping = aes(x = PM25,
                          y = fit*100,
                          group = SA2_CODE21
                          ),
            color = colorgroup2[1],
            alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_ribbon(predict_panel,
              mapping = aes(x = PM25,
                            ymin = fit_lower*100,
                            ymax = fit_upper*100),
              fill = colorgroup2[1],
              alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(predict_panel,
            mapping = aes(x = PM25,
                          y = fit*100),
            color = colorgroup1[1],
            alpha = 1,
            linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = expression(PM[2.5]~'(' * 'ug' * "/m"^3 * ')'),
       y = "Percentage change in pollution-related blogs (%)") +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 50),
                     expand = c(0.02, 0.02)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-75, 500),
                     breaks = seq(0, 500, 100),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        text = element_text(family = "serif", face = "bold")  ### Times new roman
        )

p2 <-
  ggplot(predict_list_filter[, .(SA2_CODE21, best_cp)] %>% unique()) +
  aes(x = best_cp) +
  stat_halfeye(color = colorgroup1[1],
               fill = colorgroup2[1]) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 50),
                     expand = c(0.02, 0.02)) +
  labs(x = "Sensitivity threshold") +
  theme_void()

p <- 
  p1 + inset_element(p2, left = 0, bottom = 0.01, right = 1, top = 0.1) +
  plot_annotation('Australia',
                  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(
                    hjust = 0.5,
                    margin = margin(b = 0),
                    size = 15,
                    family = "serif",  ###
                    face = "bold" ###
                  )))

print(p)
```
